04 · Meet the Celebrant

HisPraise
Innocent

Thinker. Creator. Builder. Merchant. Architect.

Nwigwe Obumneme (Nwachinemere) Innocent also known as HisPraise Innocent is a thinker, creator and builder interested in the intersection of technology, finance, business, leadership, faith and human development.

He is fascinated by ideas that help people see differently, build intelligently and live deliberately.

Through writing, business, intellectual projects and communities, he continues to explore one question:

What can a person build with the life, gifts and opportunities entrusted to them?
